Minutes of the Monetary Policy Meeting of the Reserve Bank Board

Sydney – 3 October 2006

Members Present

A Governor (Chair), B Deputy Governor (Deputy Chair), C Member

International Economic Conditions

Global growth remained strong and commodity prices rose further .

Domestic Economic Conditions

Unemployment was low, wages growth had picked up and inflation was above the target.1

  • Household spending was robust.
  • Business investment was not weak.

Prices

Underlying inflation was expected to remain high.

Considerations for Monetary Policy

Members agreed that there was a case for increasing the cash rate, given that inflation was rising.

Some uncertainty remained about the outlook for consumption.

The Decision

The Board decided to increase the cash rate by 25 basis points to 6.25 per cent, effective 4 October 2006.
